description: Database admin UIs shipped to production in a small monorepo: the web app's package.json start script runs Prisma Studio alongside next start (Railway/Render run `npm start`), and the reporting service's compose.yaml (Compose's default file name, as `docker init` generates it) runs Drizzle Studio bound to 0.0.0.0 with its port published. Either gives anyone who finds the port full read/write access to every table. VC157 must fire on both.
